header:
name: Software WGSL smoke

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  software-wgpu:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    env:
      FLEXPART_GPU_SOFTWARE: "1"
      FLEXPART_GPU_CANDIDATE_REVISION: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      WGPU_BACKEND: vulkan
      LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: "1"

steps.name: Install Rust toolchain
steps.block:
name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt

steps.name: Identify runner image for Cargo cache
steps.block:
name: Identify runner image for Cargo cache
        id: cache-environment
        run: echo "image=$ImageVersion" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Restore trusted Cargo compilation cache
steps.block:
name: Restore trusted Cargo compilation cache
        id: cargo-cache
        # Pull requests may read scoped trusted caches, but never publish them.
        # GitHub also prevents protected branches from reading feature/PR caches.
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6
        with:
          workspaces: ". -> target"
          key: ubuntu-22.04-${{ runner.arch }}-default-features-${{ steps.cache-environment.outputs.image }}-${{ hashFiles('**/build.rs', '**/.cargo/config*') }}
          env-vars: "RUST CARGO CC CXX CFLAGS CXXFLAGS LDFLAGS"
          cache-targets: "false"
          # Only compiler artifacts enter the archive; reports/oracle outputs
          # are excluded even if the action cleanup cannot remove a file.
          cache-directories: |
            target/debug/deps
            target/debug/build
            target/debug/.fingerprint
            target/release/deps
            target/release/build
            target/release/.fingerprint
            .cargo-cache-integrity
          cache-workspace-crates: "false"
          cache-bin: "false"
          save-if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}

steps.name: Verify restored Cargo compilation bytes
steps.block:
name: Verify restored Cargo compilation bytes
        run: python3 scripts/cargo_cache_integrity.py verify

steps.name: Audit CI test coverage and fail-closed checks
steps.block:
name: Audit CI test coverage and fail-closed checks
        run: |
          python3 scripts/check_ci_test_coverage.py
          python3 scripts/test_check_ci_test_coverage.py

steps.name: Check Rust formatting
steps.block:
name: Check Rust formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

steps.name: Install Lavapipe
steps.block:
name: Install Lavapipe
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends mesa-vulkan-drivers vulkan-tools
          icd=$(find /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d -name 'lvp_icd*.json' -print -quit)
          test -n "$icd"
          echo "VK_ICD_FILENAMES=$icd" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Prove H2D, WGSL arithmetic, D2H, and adapter provenance
steps.block:
name: Prove H2D, WGSL arithmetic, D2H, and adapter provenance
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/ci-gate
          cargo run --bin gpu-preflight -- --software --json-output target/ci-gate/gpu-preflight.json > target/ci-gate/gpu-preflight.log 2>&1
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          record = json.loads(Path("target/ci-gate/gpu-preflight.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          assert record["schema"] == {
              "id": "flexpart-gpu.gpu-preflight",
              "version": 1,
          }
          assert record["status"] == "passed"
          report = record["report"]
          assert report["adapter"]["adapter_class"] == "software_wgsl"
          assert report["smoke_test"]["status"] == "passed"
          assert report["smoke_test"]["actual_value"] == report["smoke_test"]["expected_value"]
          assert record["failure"] is None
          assert record["skip_reason"] is None
          PY

steps.name: Run required software WGSL advection smoke test
steps.block:
name: Run required software WGSL advection smoke test
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/ci-gate
          cargo test --test integration software_advection::test_sw_wgpu_advection_001_constant_wind_displacement -- --exact --nocapture > target/ci-gate/sw-wgpu-advection.log 2>&1
          # Fail closed: a missing adapter, a skipped test, or a missing
          # result must fail the job (never silently pass).
          grep -q "SW-WGPU-ADVECTION-001" target/ci-gate/sw-wgpu-advection.log
          grep -q "test result: ok" target/ci-gate/sw-wgpu-advection.log
          grep -qE "1 passed" target/ci-gate/sw-wgpu-advection.log
          if grep -q "FAILED" target/ci-gate/sw-wgpu-advection.log; then
            echo "SW-WGPU smoke log contains FAILED"
            exit 1
          fi
          grep -q "software_adapter=true" target/ci-gate/sw-wgpu-advection.log

steps.name: Prove accumulated-field GPU oracle parity
steps.block:
name: Prove accumulated-field GPU oracle parity
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/ci-gate
          cargo test --test accumulation_gpu -- --nocapture > target/ci-gate/accumulation-gpu.log 2>&1
          test "$(find target/ci-gate/accumulation-gpu -maxdepth 1 -name 'large_scale_precipitation-cell-*.json' | wc -l)" -eq 12
          test "$(find target/ci-gate/accumulation-gpu -maxdepth 1 -name 'convective_precipitation-cell-*.json' | wc -l)" -eq 12
          for evidence in target/ci-gate/accumulation-gpu/*.json; do
            test -s "$evidence"
            grep -q '"verdict": "passed"' "$evidence"
            grep -q '"calculation_path": "wgsl_device"' "$evidence"
            grep -q '"adapter_class": "software_wgsl"' "$evidence"
          done

steps.name: Prove temporal interpolation against the pinned FLEXPART oracle
steps.block:
name: Prove temporal interpolation against the pinned FLEXPART oracle
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --test temporal_gpu test_gpu_vs_oracle_parity -- --exact --nocapture > target/ci-gate/temporal-gpu.log 2>&1
          test -f target/temporal-gpu-evidence.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          report = json.loads(Path("target/temporal-gpu-evidence.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          assert report["schema"] == {
              "id": "flexpart-gpu.temporal-gpu-evidence",
              "version": 1,
          }
          assert report["scenario_id"] == "oracle-temporal-bilinear"
          assert report["status"] == "pass"
          assert len(report["rows"]) == 3
          for row in report["rows"]:
              assert row["row_verdict"] == "pass"
              evidence = row["gpu_evidence"]
              assert evidence["execution"]["status"] == "passed"
              assert evidence["execution"]["calculation_path"] == "wgsl_device"
              assert evidence["execution"]["adapter"]["adapter_class"] == "software_wgsl"
              assert evidence["candidate"]["revision"] == os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]
              assert evidence["oracle"]["revision"] == "c70586c2b7f5258850705325881c61f557ea9bd8"
              assert evidence["comparison"]["verdict"] == "passed"
          PY

steps.name: Prove canonical vertical GPU sampling against the pinned oracles
steps.block:
name: Prove canonical vertical GPU sampling against the pinned oracles
        env:
          FLEXPART_GPU_REQUIRE_VERTICAL: "1"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/ci-gate
          cargo test --test vertical_gpu -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 > target/ci-gate/vertical-gpu.log 2>&1
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import math
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          def read(path):
              return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

          contract = read("fixtures/interpolation/contract-v1.json")
          provenance = read("fixtures/interpolation/contract-v1.provenance.json")
          w = read("fixtures/interpolation/w-production-oracle-v1.json")
          sample = Path("src/shaders/vertical_sample.wgsl").read_bytes()
          remap = Path("src/shaders/vertical_remap_w.wgsl").read_bytes()
          for scenario in ("vertical-model-levels", "real-era5-etex-temperature-column", "w-production-synthetic"):
              is_w = scenario == "w-production-synthetic"
              if is_w:
                  expected = [q["pristine_w_m_s"] for q in w["synthetic_case"]["queries"]]
                  executable = w["provenance"]["build"]["binary_sha256"]
                  output = w["provenance"]["build"]["oracle_output_sha256"]
              else:
                  case = next(c for c in contract["cases"] if c["id"] == scenario)
                  expected = [q["VALUE"][0] for q in case["golden"]["queries"]]
                  executable = provenance["linked_flexpart"]["linked_object_set_sha256"]
                  output = provenance["cases"][scenario]
              report = read(f"target/ci-gate/vertical-gpu/{scenario}.json")
              assert report["schema"] == {"id": "flexpart-gpu.vertical-gpu-evidence", "version": 1}
              assert report["scenario_id"] == scenario and report["status"] is True
              assert len(report["rows"]) == len(expected) > 0
              shader = hashlib.sha256(sample + b"\n" + remap if is_w else sample).hexdigest()
              relative = 1e-5 if is_w else 1e-4
              assert report["comparison_policy"] == {"absolute_tolerance": 1e-6, "relative_tolerance": relative}
              for row, oracle in zip(report["rows"], expected):
                  assert row["row_verdict"] is True and row["value_verdict"] is True
                  assert math.isfinite(row["gpu_value"]) and math.isfinite(row["oracle_value"])
                  assert math.isclose(row["oracle_value"], oracle, rel_tol=1e-7, abs_tol=1e-12)
                  assert math.isclose(row["gpu_value"], oracle, rel_tol=relative, abs_tol=1e-6)
                  evidence = row["gpu_evidence"]
                  assert evidence["execution"]["status"] == "passed"
                  assert evidence["execution"]["calculation_path"] == "wgsl_device"
                  assert evidence["execution"]["adapter"]["adapter_class"] == "software_wgsl"
                  assert evidence["candidate"]["revision"] == os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]
                  assert evidence["candidate"]["shader_sha256"] == shader
                  assert evidence["oracle"]["revision"] == provenance["pinned_commit"]
                  assert evidence["oracle"]["executable_sha256"] == executable
                  assert evidence["oracle"]["output_sha256"] == output
                  assert evidence["comparison"]["verdict"] == "passed"
          PY

steps.name: Prove horizontal interpolation against the pinned FLEXPART oracle
steps.block:
name: Prove horizontal interpolation against the pinned FLEXPART oracle

          set -euo pipefail

steps.name: Prove settling against the pinned FLEXPART routines
steps.block:
name: Prove settling against the pinned FLEXPART routines
        env:
          FLEXPART_GPU_REQUIRE_SETTLING: "1"
          FLEXPART_GPU_CANDIDATE_REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -f target/settling-gpu-evidence.json
          python3 scripts/generate_settling_oracle.py --audit
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_generate_settling_oracle.py
          cargo test --test settling_gpu -- --nocapture > target/ci-gate/settling-gpu.log 2>&1
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          import subprocess
          import struct
          from pathlib import Path

          def read(path):
              return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())

          report = read("target/settling-gpu-evidence.json")
          canonical = read("fixtures/settling/canonical-vectors-v1.json")
          oracle = read("fixtures/settling/oracle-v1.json")
          actual = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
          assert actual == os.environ["FLEXPART_GPU_CANDIDATE_REVISION"]
          assert report["schema"] == {"id": "flexpart-gpu.settling-gpu-evidence", "version": 1}
          assert report["status"] is True
          assert len(report["rows"]) == len(canonical["vectors"]) == 32
          assert {row["vector_id"] for row in report["rows"]} == {v["id"] for v in canonical["vectors"]}
          shader = Path("src/shaders/settling_velocity.wgsl").read_bytes().decode().replace("__WORKGROUP_SIZE_X__", "64")
          shader_hash = hashlib.sha256(shader.encode()).hexdigest()
          values = {v["id"]: v["settling_velocity_m_s"] for v in oracle["values"]}
          for row in report["rows"]:
              assert row["row_verdict"] is True
              assert struct.pack("!f", row["oracle_settling_velocity_m_s"]) == struct.pack("!f", values[row["vector_id"]])
              evidence = row["gpu_evidence"]
              assert evidence["execution"]["status"] == "passed"
              assert evidence["execution"]["calculation_path"] == "wgsl_device"
              assert evidence["execution"]["adapter"]["adapter_class"] == "software_wgsl"
              assert evidence["candidate"]["revision"] == actual
              assert evidence["candidate"]["shader_sha256"] == shader_hash
              assert evidence["oracle"]["revision"] == oracle["pinned_revision"]
              assert evidence["oracle"]["executable_sha256"] == oracle["executable_sha256"]
              assert evidence["oracle"]["output_sha256"] == oracle["output_sha256"]
              assert evidence["comparison"]["verdict"] == "passed"
          PY

steps.name: Prove resident particle meteorology queries and fatal-batch gating
steps.block:
name: Prove resident particle meteorology queries and fatal-batch gating
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/ci-gate
          cargo test --test meteorology_resident -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 > target/ci-gate/meteorology-resident.log 2>&1
          cargo test --lib gpu::meteorology::resident::tests -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 > target/ci-gate/meteorology-resident-corner.log 2>&1
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import subprocess
          from pathlib import Path

          report = json.loads(Path('target/ci-gate/meteorology-resident/report.json').read_text())
          assert report['schema'] == {'id': 'flexpart-gpu.meteorology-resident', 'version': 1}
          assert report['passed'] is True
          assert report['revision'] == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
          assert report['adapter']['adapter_class'] == 'software_wgsl'
          paths = ['particle_query', 'resident_status_reset', 'resident_query_adapter', 'horizontal_interpolation',
                   'vertical_sample', 'temporal_interpolation', 'resident_sample_status', 'resident_fixture_consumer']
          shaders = '\n'.join(Path(f'src/shaders/{p}.wgsl').read_text() for p in paths)
          assert report['shader_bundle_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(shaders.encode()).hexdigest()
          cases = {c['id']: c for c in report['cases']}
          required = {'surface-active-1', 'surface-active-3', 'surface-active-4', 'inactive-nonfinite-lane',
                      'negative-signed-cell-memory-safe', 'reuse-after-fatal-status-reset',
                      'nonfinite-fraction', 'nonfinite-height', 'invalid-fraction', 'outside-cell',
                      'nonperiodic-east-overshoot', 'north-overshoot', 'nonperiodic-exact-east-north',
                      'split-cell-fraction-survives-endpoint-rounding', 'fatal-across-workgroups',
                      'reuse-with-empty-active-prefix', 'model-distinct-compatible-profiles-lower-interior-upper',
                      'within-stencil-differing-geometry-owned-by-118',
                      'pinned-periodic-edge-0', 'pinned-periodic-edge-1', 'pinned-periodic-edge-2'}
          assert set(cases) == required
          assert report['static_grid_context_time_rejection'] is True
          for c in cases.values():
              assert c['passed'] is True
              assert c['submission_count'] == 1 and c['intermediate_d2h_count'] == 0
              assert c['host_prepare_sample'] is False
              assert c['metadata']['component_count'] == c['metadata']['lane_stride'] == 1
              assert len(c['status']['lanes']) == c['metadata']['capacity']
              assert len(c['query_inputs']) == c['metadata']['capacity']
              assert len(c['input_sha256']) == 64
              assert c['order'] == ['device_status_reset', 'particle_producer', 'resident_adapter', 'canonical_sampling',
                                    'device_result_status', 'status_guarded_fixture_consumer']
          assert cases['negative-signed-cell-memory-safe']['status']['lanes'][1] == 3
          assert cases['within-stencil-differing-geometry-owned-by-118']['status']['lanes'][1] == 7
          assert cases['fatal-across-workgroups']['status']['fatal'] is True
          assert cases['reuse-after-fatal-status-reset']['status'] == {'fatal': False, 'lanes': [2, 2, 2, 2]}
          PY

steps.name: Prove field-specific canonical meteorology composition
steps.block:
name: Prove field-specific canonical meteorology composition
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --test meteorology_composition -- --test-threads=1 > target/ci-gate/meteorology-composition.log 2>&1
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import math
          import subprocess
          from pathlib import Path

          directory = Path("target/ci-gate/meteorology-composition")
          report = json.loads((directory / "report.json").read_text())
          assert report["schema"] == {"id": "flexpart-gpu.meteorology-composition-evidence", "version": 1}
          assert report["candidate_revision"] == subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
          assert report["composition_source_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(Path("src/gpu/meteorology.rs").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          assert report["test_source_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(Path("tests/meteorology_composition.rs").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          sample = Path("src/shaders/vertical_sample.wgsl").read_bytes()
          remap = Path("src/shaders/vertical_remap_w.wgsl").read_bytes()
          assert report["stage_shader_sha256"] == {
              "horizontal": hashlib.sha256(Path("src/shaders/horizontal_interpolation.wgsl").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "vertical": hashlib.sha256(sample).hexdigest(),
              "w_bundle": hashlib.sha256(sample + b"\n" + remap).hexdigest(),
              "temporal": hashlib.sha256(Path("src/shaders/temporal_interpolation.wgsl").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "accumulation": hashlib.sha256(Path("src/shaders/accumulated_interval.wgsl").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          }
          assert report["status"] == "passed"
          execution = report["execution"]
          assert execution["status"] == "passed"
          assert execution["calculation_path"] == "wgsl_device"
          assert execution["adapter"]["adapter_class"] == "software_wgsl"
          assert report["residency_proof"]["caller_composition_submissions"] == 1
          assert report["residency_proof"]["intermediate_readbacks"] == 0
          expected_cases = {
              "instantaneous-surface", "surface-first-endpoint", "surface-last-endpoint",
              "model-agl", "model-asl", "model-below-domain", "model-above-domain",
              "interface-w", "interval-leading-rate", "interval-delta-amount",
              "interval-reset-si-rate", "interval-total", "interval-mean-flux",
              "static-class", "static-scalar",
              "surface-later-bracket", "center-w",
              "model-northward-wind", "model-temperature", "model-specific-humidity",
          }
          assert len(report["rows"]) == len(expected_cases)
          assert {row["case_id"] for row in report["rows"]} == expected_cases
          def record(stage, source=None, plane=None):
              return {"stage": stage, "source_index": source, "plane_index": plane}

          for row in report["rows"]:
              case = row["case_id"]
              assert row["status"] == "passed"
              assert json.loads((directory / (case + ".json")).read_text()) == row
              selected = [0]
              stages = []
              if case.startswith("model-") or case == "center-w":
                  selected = [0, 1]
                  for source in selected:
                      stages += [record("horizontal", source, plane) for plane in range(3)]
                      stages += [record("vertical", source)]
                  stages += [record("temporal")]
                  copies = 10
              elif case == "interface-w":
                  selected = [0, 1]
                  for source in selected:
                      stages += [record("w_remap", source), record("vertical", source)]
                  stages += [record("temporal")]
                  copies = 4
              elif case in {"instantaneous-surface", "surface-first-endpoint", "surface-last-endpoint", "surface-later-bracket"}:
                  selected = [1, 2] if case in {"surface-last-endpoint", "surface-later-bracket"} else [0, 1]
                  stages = [record("horizontal", source, 0) for source in selected] + [record("temporal")]
                  copies = 4
              elif case in {"interval-leading-rate", "interval-delta-amount", "interval-reset-si-rate"}:
                  source = {"interval-leading-rate": 0, "interval-delta-amount": 1, "interval-reset-si-rate": 2}[case]
                  stages = [record("accumulated_transform"), record("horizontal", source, 0)]
                  selected = [0, 1, 2]
                  copies = 2
              else:
                  copies = 13 if case == "static-class" else 1
                  stages = [record("horizontal", 0, plane) for plane in range(copies)]
              assert row["encoded_stages"] == row["expected_stage_records"] == stages
              assert row["expected_stages"] == [s["stage"] for s in stages]
              assert row["device_to_device_copies"] == copies
              inputs = (directory / (row["case_id"] + "-inputs.json")).read_bytes()
              assert row["input_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(inputs).hexdigest()
              inputs = json.loads(inputs)
              metadata = row["metadata"]
              handoff = (directory / (case + "-handoff.json")).read_bytes()
              assert row["handoff_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(handoff).hexdigest()
              assert json.loads(handoff) == metadata
              assert inputs["request"] == metadata["request"]
              downstream_fields = {
                  "model-northward-wind": ("wind_v", "meter_per_second", "positive_northward"),
                  "model-temperature": ("temperature", "kelvin", "signed_scalar"),
                  "model-specific-humidity": ("specific_humidity", "kilogram_per_kilogram", "non_negative"),
              }
              if case in downstream_fields:
                  assert (metadata["field_id"], metadata["unit"], metadata["sign"]) == downstream_fields[case]
              snapshots = []
              hashes = []
              for index, snapshot in enumerate(inputs["snapshots"]):
                  source = (directory / f"{case}-source-{index}.json").read_bytes()
                  assert json.loads(source) == snapshot
                  snapshots.append(snapshot)
                  hashes.append(hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest())
              assert metadata["source_snapshot_sha256"] == [hashes[i] for i in selected]
              fields = [next(f for f in snapshots[i]["fields"] if f["id"] == metadata["field_id"]) for i in selected]
              assert metadata["source_times"] == [f["time"] for f in fields]
              unit = {
                  "interval-leading-rate": "millimeter_per_hour",
                  "interval-delta-amount": "kilogram_per_square_meter",
                  "interval-reset-si-rate": "kilogram_per_square_meter_per_second",
              }.get(case, fields[0]["unit"])
              assert metadata["unit"] == unit
              for key in ("sign", "horizontal_staggering", "vertical_staggering"):
                  assert all(f[key] == metadata[key] for f in fields)
              assert all(snapshots[i]["horizontal_grid"] == metadata["horizontal_grid"] for i in selected)
              bracket = metadata["temporal_bracket"]
              if any(s["stage"] == "temporal" for s in stages):
                  assert [bracket["lower_index"], bracket["upper_index"]] == selected
                  assert bracket["source_timestamps"] == {
                      "lower_epoch_seconds": fields[0]["time"]["valid_time_epoch_seconds"],
                      "upper_epoch_seconds": fields[1]["time"]["valid_time_epoch_seconds"],
                  }
              else:
                  assert bracket is None
              count = row["metadata"]["value_count"]
              assert count == (13 if case == "static-class" else 1)
              assert len(row["candidate_values"]) == len(row["expected_values"]) == count
              assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in row["candidate_values"] + row["expected_values"])
              assert row["comparison"]["verdict"] == "passed"
              assert row["comparison"]["compared_value_count"] == count
              assert row["comparison"]["first_failure"] is None
              policy = row["comparison"]["policy"]
              relative = 1e-4 if case.startswith("model-") or case == "center-w" else 1e-5
              if stages[0]["stage"] == "accumulated_transform":
                  relative = 1e-6
              assert policy == {"absolute_tolerance": 1e-6, "relative_tolerance": relative}
              for actual, expected in zip(row["candidate_values"], row["expected_values"]):
                  error = abs(actual - expected)
                  assert error <= policy["absolute_tolerance"] or error <= policy["relative_tolerance"] * max(abs(actual), abs(expected))
              assert row["metadata"]["source_snapshot_sha256"]
              assert len(row["metadata"]["geometry_identity"]) == len(row["metadata"]["geometry_provenance"])
              expected_geometries = inputs["expected_geometries"]
              assert metadata["geometry_identity"] == [g["identity"] for g in expected_geometries]
              assert metadata["geometry_provenance"] == [g["provenance"] for g in expected_geometries]
              assert metadata["resolved_heights_agl_m"] == [g["height_agl_m"] for g in expected_geometries]
              geometries = metadata["geometry_provenance"]
              assert len(geometries) == (2 if any(s["stage"] == "vertical" for s in stages) else 0)
              assert [g["source_snapshot_sha256"] for g in geometries] == (metadata["source_snapshot_sha256"] if geometries else [])
              assert len(metadata["motion_provenance"]) == (2 if case in {"interface-w", "center-w"} else 0)
          for reference in report["stage_evidence_references"]:
              path = Path(reference)
              assert path.exists(), reference
              assert list(path.glob("*.json")) if path.is_dir() else path.stat().st_size > 0
          PY

steps.name: Prove canonical driver input and resident resource readiness (#173)
steps.block:
name: Prove canonical driver input and resident resource readiness (#173)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test --test canonical_timeloop_meteorology -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 > target/ci-gate/canonical-timeloop-meteorology.log 2>&1
          grep -q 'CANONICAL-MET-173' target/ci-gate/canonical-timeloop-meteorology.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import math
          import subprocess
          from pathlib import Path

          r = json.loads(Path('target/ci-gate/canonical-timeloop-meteorology/report.json').read_text())
          assert r['schema'] == {'id': 'flexpart-gpu.canonical-timeloop-meteorology', 'version': 1}
          assert r['revision'] == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
          assert r['passed'] and r['calculation_path'] == 'wgsl_device'
          assert len(r['adapters']) == 2
          assert all(a['adapter_class'] == 'software_wgsl' for a in r['adapters'])
          assert r['inputs'] == json.loads(r['input_json'])
          assert r['input_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(r['input_json'].encode()).hexdigest()
          names = ['particle_query', 'resident_status_reset', 'resident_query_adapter', 'horizontal_interpolation',
                   'vertical_sample', 'temporal_interpolation', 'resident_sample_status', 'resident_fixture_consumer']
          shaders = '\n'.join(Path(f'src/shaders/{n}.wgsl').read_text() for n in names)
          assert r['shader_bundle_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(shaders.encode()).hexdigest()
          for key in ['same_bracket_reused', 'source_change_rebuilt', 'motion_lineage_change_rebuilt',
                      'retained_owner_executed_after_transition', 'failed_preflight_preserved_slot', 'reused_across_mutable_driver_steps']:
              assert r[key]
          brackets = r['source_brackets']
          assert set(brackets) == {'original', 'changed', 'lineage'}
          for bracket in brackets.values():
              identity = bracket['identity']
              assert identity['field_ids'] == ['wind_u', 'wind_v', 'vertical_velocity']
              assert len(bracket['snapshot_json']) == len(bracket['native_motion_json']) == len(bracket['runtimes']) == 2
              for index, (source, native, runtime) in enumerate(zip(bracket['snapshot_json'], bracket['native_motion_json'], bracket['runtimes'])):
                  assert hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() == identity['source_snapshot_sha256'][index]
                  assert runtime['provenance'] == identity['geometry_provenance'][index]
                  assert runtime['provenance']['source_snapshot_sha256'] == identity['source_snapshot_sha256'][index]
                  motion = runtime['vertical_velocity']
                  assert motion['provenance'] == identity['motion_provenance'][index]
                  assert hashlib.sha256(native.encode()).hexdigest() == motion['provenance']['source_native_motion_sha256']
                  assert json.loads(native)['provenance']['source_id'] == motion['provenance']['source_id']
                  w = next(f for f in json.loads(source)['fields'] if f['id'] == 'vertical_velocity')
                  assert motion['values_ms'] == w['values'] == json.loads(native)['values']
                  assert motion['vertical_staggering'] == w['vertical_staggering'] == 'level_center'
          assert brackets['original']['identity'] == r['identity']
          assert brackets['changed']['identity']['source_snapshot_sha256'] != brackets['original']['identity']['source_snapshot_sha256']
          assert brackets['lineage']['snapshot_json'] == brackets['changed']['snapshot_json']
          assert brackets['lineage']['identity']['motion_provenance'] != brackets['changed']['identity']['motion_provenance']
          directions = {'forward', 'backward', 'retained-forward', 'changed-source', 'next-forward', 'next-backward'}
          expected_brackets = {direction: 'original' for direction in directions}
          expected_brackets.update({'changed-source': 'changed', 'next-forward': 'lineage'})
          assert len(r['rows']) == 36
          assert {row['direction'] for row in r['rows']} == directions
          for direction in directions:
              rows = [row for row in r['rows'] if row['direction'] == direction]
              assert {(row['metadata']['field_id'], row['selection']) for row in rows} == {
                  (field, selection) for field in ['wind_u', 'wind_v', 'vertical_velocity'] for selection in ['current', 'predicted']}
          for row in r['rows']:
              assert row['source_bracket'] == expected_brackets[row['direction']]
              bracket = brackets[row['source_bracket']]
              metadata = row['metadata']
              sources = [json.loads(source) for source in bracket['snapshot_json']]
              fields = [next(f for f in source['fields'] if f['id'] == metadata['field_id']) for source in sources]
              for key in ['source_snapshot_sha256', 'geometry_identity', 'geometry_provenance']:
                  assert metadata[key] == bracket['identity'][key]
              assert metadata['source_times'] == [field['time'] for field in fields]
              assert all(metadata['horizontal_grid'] == source['horizontal_grid'] for source in sources)
              assert all(metadata[key] == field[key] for field in fields for key in ['unit', 'sign', 'horizontal_staggering', 'vertical_staggering'])
              assert row['passed'] and row['comparison']['verdict'] == 'passed'
              assert row['status'] == {'fatal': False, 'lanes': [2]}
              assert row['submission_count'] == 1 and row['intermediate_d2h_count'] == 0
              assert len(row['output']) == 1
              assert math.isfinite(row['output'][0]) and math.isfinite(row['expected'])
              assert set(metadata['time']) == {'instantaneous'}
              request = metadata['time']['instantaneous']['epoch_seconds']
              assert all(metadata['time']['instantaneous']['calendar'] == field['time']['calendar'] for field in fields)
              lower, upper = [field['time']['valid_time_epoch_seconds'] for field in fields]
              assert lower <= request <= upper
              alpha = (request - lower) / (upper - lower)
              expected = fields[0]['values'][0] * (1 - alpha) + fields[1]['values'][0] * alpha
              assert row['expected'] == expected
              policy = row['comparison']['policy']
              assert policy == {'absolute_tolerance': 1e-6, 'relative_tolerance': 1e-4}
              assert math.isclose(row['output'][0], expected, abs_tol=policy['absolute_tolerance'], rel_tol=policy['relative_tolerance'])
              assert row['metadata']['unit'] == 'meter_per_second'
              assert row['metadata']['vertical_staggering'] == 'level_center'
              assert row['metadata']['horizontal_grid'] == r['inputs']['snapshots'][0]['horizontal_grid']
              assert len(row['metadata']['geometry_identity']) == 2
          PY

steps.name: Run corpus deterministic subset (Issue #6, point 2)
steps.block:
name: Run corpus deterministic subset (Issue #6, point 2)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p target/ci-gate
          # Small deterministic selection only: analytic advection, neutral
          # production smoke, repeatability, isolated deposition analytic and
          # the blocked-dependency gate. The larger 10-seed corpus stays local
          # via scripts/run-corpus.sh (see docs/corpus-matrix.md).
          # NOTE: cargo exit status is captured without a pipe so the
          # successful summary line ("6 passed; 0 failed") can never be
          # misread as a failure.
          set +e
          cargo test --test integration corpus_ -- --nocapture > target/ci-gate/corpus-subset.log 2>&1
          cargo_status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$cargo_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit "$cargo_status"
          fi
          grep -q "test result: ok" target/ci-gate/corpus-subset.log
          grep -qE "[1-9][0-9]* passed; 0 failed" target/ci-gate/corpus-subset.log
          # No skipped corpus test may hide behind a passing suite: every
          # corpus test must either pass or the job fails here.
          if grep -q "no WGSL adapter" target/ci-gate/corpus-subset.log; then
            echo "Corpus subset skipped (no adapter); failing closed"
            exit 1
          fi

name: Prove canonical forward and backward production advection
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for mode in production validation compaction; do
            export FLEXPART_GPU_VALIDATION=0 FLEXPART_GPU_COMPACTION=0
            if [ "$mode" = validation ]; then export FLEXPART_GPU_VALIDATION=1; fi
            if [ "$mode" = compaction ]; then export FLEXPART_GPU_COMPACTION=1; fi
            cargo test --lib gpu::meteorology::advection_production_tests -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 > "target/ci-gate/resident-advection-$mode.log" 2>&1
            grep -q 'RESIDENT-ADVECTION-112' "target/ci-gate/resident-advection-$mode.log"
            grep -q 'RESIDENT-ADVECTION-112-DEFERRED' "target/ci-gate/resident-advection-$mode.log"
            python3 scripts/check_resident_advection_evidence.py
            if [ "$mode" = production ]; then python3 scripts/test_check_resident_advection_evidence.py; fi
            cp target/ci-gate/resident-advection-production/interior-deferred-boundary.json "target/ci-gate/resident-advection-production/$mode-interior-deferred-boundary.json"
            cp target/ci-gate/resident-advection-production/report.json "target/ci-gate/resident-advection-production/$mode-report.json"
